programme.desc: Rahsia yang di simpan selama 30 tahun akhirnya terbongkar dan menimbulkan konflik dalam 2 buah keluarga yang berada di Kuala Lumpur dan juga Yogyakarta.

programme.title: Kami The Movie
programme.desc: Lima sahabat karib berkongsi kisah suka duka kehidupan termasuklah konflik keluarga, penyalahgunaan dadah, cinta dan persahabatan.

programme.title: Citra Exclusive: Aku, Mawar & Makhluk Asing
programme.desc: Apabila tunang yang garang tiba-tiba berubah menjadi seorang wanita yang lemah lembut, maka Bart jatuh cinta kembali pada tunangnya, Mawar. Tapi, adakah itu Mawar yang sebenar?

programme.title: Bidaah Ep6
programme.desc: Bimbang dengan ketaksuban ibunya kepada Walid Muhammad, pemimpin misteri Jihad Ummah, Baiduri berusaha untuk membongkar kebenaran di sebalik ajaran kumpulan itu.

programme.title: A Deadly Legend
programme.desc: Joan Huntar, seorang pemaju hartanah, membeli sebuah kem musim panas yang lama. Ternyata hartanah itu pernah didiami oleh sekumpulan orang penyangak dengan sejarah hitam.

programme.title: Once Upon A Kopitiam Ep1
programme.desc: Mr. Xiao, owner of Heng Hock kopitiam, feels as if he has reached the twilight year of his year & intends to shut down his business. It is made worse when he suddenly collapses.

programme.title: Nafsu Ep2
programme.desc: Selepas kejadian aneh di kelab malam, Alia dilihat berjalan seorang diri di bandar raya dalam keadaan dirasuk. Sam mengambil keputusan untuk berdepan dengan trauma masa lalunya demi membantu Dina.

programme.title: Ex Aku Pontianak Ep4
programme.desc: Malik dan Suraya lari dari Amran dan Zafran. Malik takut balik rumah lalu tumpang tidur rumah Suraya. Malik cadangkan untuk Suraya ekori Fifi dan Jay yang rupanya ke Pontibar.

programme.title: Karya 12 Vol. 2: Gadis Kosmos
programme.desc: Trilogi Kekasih Elektrik dan Aku, Mawar & Makhluk Asing di mana Bart dan Amri kini di fasa perpisahan dengan pasangan mereka. Fenomena aneh berlaku di mana seorang wanita cantik muncul mengisi hati mereka

programme.title: Lesen Besar
programme.desc: Tiga sekawan yang rindu zaman bujang mereka telah merancang untuk pergi 'road trip' setelah mendapat pelepasan daripada isteri dan teman wanita masing-masing. Tapi nasib tidak menyebelahi mereka di sepanja

programme.title: Sekolah Sampah
programme.desc: Adam adalah seorang backpacker tekah mengorbankan impian pengembaraannya apabila nekad membina "Sekolah Sampah" demi mendidik anak-anak di satu tempat pembuangan sampah.

programme.title: Kimchi Untuk Awak
programme.desc: Bella, pelajar universiti di Korea Selatan pulang ke Malaysia untuk menghabiskan cuti semester tetapi ketenangan mula bertukar menjadi huru-hara selepas bertemu dengan lelaki Melayu-Korea bernama Daniel.

programme.title: i-Tanggang Ep7
programme.desc: Sepanjang hidupnya, Khalil sakit akibat ubat yang diberi oleh ibunya, Erma sehingga menyebabkan dia selalu pengsan. Syafiq pula terpaksa keluar bekerja mencari nafkah untuk keluarganya.

programme.title: Citra Exclusive: Ooops! Terlajak Nikah
programme.desc: Seorang jejaka ingin mengahwini seorang gadis muda dan menghantar rombongan meminang. Tiba hari pernikahan dan rupa-rupanya dia telah tersalah meminang dan mengahwini seorang janda yang lebih tua darinya!

programme.title: Scoop
programme.desc: Seorang wartawan perempuan bertekad dengan penuh nekad untuk membongkar skandal perniagaan songsang seorang kenamaan yang mencurigakannya.

programme.title: The Apartment Ep1
programme.desc: Karin pulang dari Jakarta setelah selesai penggambaran travelognya. Kembali bertemu dengan kawan, jiran, dan peminat. Tapi segalanya di pangsapuri telah berubah jadi berhantu.

programme.title: Gol & Gincu
programme.desc: Demi seorang lelaki, Putri sanggup belajar main futsal. Filem remaja kontemporari lakonan Nur Fazura dan Sazzy Falak, Pelakon Wanita Pembantu Terbaik FFM19.

programme.title: Citra Exclusive: Cekelat Semanis Honey
programme.desc: Adam, seorang pelakon terkenal secara tidak sengaja terjumpa sebuah cafe untuk bersembunyi daripada paparazi. Cafe tersebut dipunyai oleh seorang ibu tunggal yang langsung tidak mengenali Adam.

programme.title: Bidaah Ep7
programme.desc: Bimbang dengan ketaksuban ibunya kepada Walid Muhammad, pemimpin misteri Jihad Ummah, Baiduri berusaha untuk membongkar kebenaran di sebalik ajaran kumpulan itu.

programme.desc: Silva will track Manju with Ameetha's assistant. They both will try to speak to her and explain that her life is in danger and she could be the next target. Manju refuses to listen.

programme.desc: Jay skeptikal bila pemburu pontianak cari mereka. Jay dan Fifi terkejut Bella ada di rumah mereka. Bella ceritakan Malik curang. Fifi rasa kasihan tapi Jay pula nak siasat Bella.

programme.desc: Mat So'od merupakan penglipurlara di kampungnya. Namun berlawanan dengan kerjayanya, Mat So'od merupakan seorang pemurung hampir sepanjang hidupnya.

programme.desc: In this retelling of China's most popular romance, superstar Ivy Ling Po plays a scholar who tries to seduce a servant.

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: Wang Yu grows from a playful boy to a reformation hero against the Ching Dynasty, rising to protect his homeland and loved ones.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Pat Ting Hung, Carrie Ku Mei and Li Hsiang Chun star in this delightful tale of mistaken identities caused by monogrammed handkerchiefs.

programme.title: Five Elements Ninjas
programme.desc: When evil ninjas brutally slaughter students from a noble Chinese kung-fu academy, the one survivor forms a powerful group to avenge his fallen comrades.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: When deadbeats Ming and Liang stumble upon records of scandals involving government officials, what follows is a humorous misadventure of epic proportions.

programme.title: Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Ti Lung returns as Li Chin Huan, the renowned swordsman who must face the Chief of the Money Clan and his legion of assassins for the fate of the 'Martial Arts World'.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The Mad Monk rushes around saving hawkers from crumbling walls and bullies, recovering stolen money and punishing a ruthless court official and his son.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Actress Lily Ho plays the feared swordswoman Silver Fox, who witnessed her father senseless maiming and her mother's rape. 18 years later, it's payback time.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: Three sisters (the quietest and most filial of whom is played by Cheng Pei Pei) attempt to sing and dance their way to happiness.

programme.title: Oath of Death
programme.desc: When Sung Dynasty patriot Chin Liang runs afoul of a corrupt acquaintance, he is forced to avenge the villain's treachery via a self-sacrificing oath.

programme.title: Facets of Love
programme.desc: In this king of epic dramas, three sexy vignettes are set against a Ming Dynasty brothel that steams with erotic myths, secret trysts and pleasurable twists.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: When Ko Chien, a downtrodden kung fu student seeks to save the life of a kung fu master and learn new skills, fate labels him a traitor instead.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: This drama centres on the seductive Judy. A woman with a rich husband, she also has two lovers who happen to be brothers!

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: Set in the Han Dynasty, this drama depicts the legendary beauty Diao Chan, and how she used her charms to help her godfather eradicate corrupt court officials.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Adapted from the novel Water Margin and starring Ti Lung, this award-winning drama depicts how the courageous Wu Song defeats a tiger, and his bond with Wu Da Lang.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: This epic depicts the romance between the Jade Emperor's seventh daughter and a young village man. When Heaven and Earth meet, can a common ground be found?

programme.title: The Black Lizard
programme.desc: Kung-fu takes on a macabre, horrific flair in this stunning story of swordsmen and women struggling to save their true loves and their sanity.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: A kind Emperor lands himself in big trouble when he begins frequenting the gambling dens to learn what makes his subjects tick. Stars Anthony Lau, Wong Yue.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Chinese martial arts student (Wang Yu) trains hard to defeat the karate expert (Lo Lieh) who brutally killed his master and peers.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: This compelling Shaw Brothers Huangmei Opera depicts the romance of star-crossed lovers the son of a respected government official and a famed prostitute.

programme.title: Wits of the Brats
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng both co-stars and co-directs his brother Chang Chan-peng in this all-out action comedy featuring the best in the business.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: Attracted by a sensual rain dance performed by three tribeswomen, three snake siblings set in motion a tale of romance, lust and tragedy.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: A dying crime lord sends a gang of assassins to steal a special herb that may cure him. However, they become the targets of a couple on a vendetta.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Problems ensue after one of two childhood friends who have vowed to become sisters through the exchange of bracelets gets married.

programme.title: Killer Darts
programme.desc: Bandits disturb the peace until a martial artist and his student, son and servant go to avenge his murdered wife and set things right.

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin loyalists (led by Alexander Fu Sheng and Chen Kuan Tai) go up against a formidable Manchu general and his Tibetan allies.

programme.title: The Golden Buddha
programme.desc: A ruthless gang goes up against a millionaire's daughter who has one of three priceless Golden Buddha statues.

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: See how Prince 4 tries his hardest to kill the heir apparent, Prince 14 and how, out of frustration, he finally engages an assassin to do the job.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: Based on a famed Chinese opera, this melodramatic film depicts the romance between Zhang Sheng, an impoverished scholar, and Ying Ying, who is from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Love Without End
programme.desc: This classic romance stars Linda Lin and Kwan Shan| capturing a touching love story between a famous nightclub singer and a young architect.

programme.title: The Warlord

programme.title: The Flying Dagger

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers

programme.title: The Purple Shell

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
